item.title: Agile and Controllable Omnidirectional Fast-start Maneuvers of Robotic Fish via Bio-inspired Reinforcement Learning
item.description: This project introduces BASS, an innovative data-driven control framework that breaks free from the periodic constraints of traditional CPGs. By coupling a high-fidelity CFD environment with a biological two-stage reward mechanism, we achieve non-periodic, high-burst omnidirectional fast-start maneuvers on a multi-joint robotic fish, successfully bridging the Sim2Real gap in transient fluid dynamics.
